title: Steering with Multilingual Lexicons for Sentiment Control in Low-Resource Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.03317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling model behavior, but existing methods depend on sentence-level contrastive data that is unavailable for most of the world's languages. We show that multilingual sentiment lexicons are a viable substitute across three model families: aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain stronger for languages a model has specialized in during pre-training. The steering efficacy is mechanistically dictated by both representational density and pre-training priors. Large-magnitude English vectors overwhelm the compact representations of low-resource languages, causing "linguistic collapse." This fragility is mitigated by the norm-dampening of multilingual aggregation. Architectural biases, including bilingual specialization penalty and latent numerical rigidity, also heavily constrain

translated_title: 利用多语言词典进行激活导向以实现低资源语言的情感控制
translated_abstract: 激活导向为控制模型行为提供了一种轻量级机制，但现有方法依赖于句子级对比数据，而世界上大多数语言都无法获得这类数据。我们证明，多语言情感词典是三种模型家族中可行的替代方案：对于中低资源语言，聚合的多语言词典优于源自英语的导向向量；而对于模型在预训练期间专门学习过的语言，单语言词典仍然更强。导向效果在机制上由表示密度和预训练先验共同决定。大幅度值的英语向量会压垮低资源语言的紧凑表示，导致“语言坍塌”现象。多语言聚合所带来的范数阻尼效应可以缓解这种脆弱性。此外，架构偏见——包括双语特化惩罚和潜在数值刚性——也严重限制了（导向的效果）……
tldr: 该论文提出用多语言情感词典替代句子级对比数据来实现激活导向的情感控制，证明聚合多语言词典对低资源语言优于英语导向向量，并从机制上揭示了“语言坍塌”现象及架构偏见的约束作用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using multilingual sentiment lexicons as a substitute for sentence-level contrastive data in activation steering, showing that aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for low-resource languages, while mechanistically revealing the "linguistic collapse" phenomenon and architectural bias constraints.
